_about: Crafting recipes (D106, D107). Each: id (never change it once used), name, category (for the list), seconds (how long it takes: the world goes on meanwhile, and getting hurt interrupts it; nothing is used up until it's done), inputs (used up: [item or tag:<tag>, count]), tools (kept: each entry a list of alternatives, an item id or tag:<tag>), outputs ([item, count]), and a line of flavour. A tag (items.json) means any item that has it: tag:clean_water is a bottle of water or of mineral water, tag:water_container anything that holds water (a saucepan, a mug, a bottle), tag:sharp a knife or scissors, tag:fire a lighter or matches. What an input leaves behind (an empty bottle) comes back by itself. D111: heat (true) means it must be made over a heat source: a burning campfire within reach, or a camping stove with a gas canister in the pack (each use may empty the canister). places: what it puts on the ground instead of into the pack ("campfire": outdoors only). leftovers (default true): false when what the inputs leave behind is already in the outputs (boiling river water gives the bottle back as a bottle of water). D112: book: the id of the book that teaches it; until you've read that book the recipe can't be made (the list shows where to learn it). No book: everyone knows it. D113: skill: the skill it trains (10 XP a make, 15 from a book recipe) and that makes it faster (skills.json). D114: evolve: "bigos" makes a recipe change a pot of bigos in the pack instead of making something new; adds: the ingredient letter it puts in (K sauerkraut, C cabbage, M meat, G mushrooms, P prunes, O onion) or "reheat". D119: name_pl and about_pl are the Polish name and flavour line.

recipes.name: Build a campfire
recipes.about: Stones in a ring, paper underneath, wood on top. Ten minutes of fire, more if you feed it. Seen from far away at night.
recipes.about_pl: Kamienie w krąg, papier na spód, drewno na wierzch. Dziesięć minut ognia, dłużej, jeśli dokładasz. W nocy widać go z daleka.

recipes.name: Tear a bed sheet into rags
recipes.about: Not your grandmother's linen any more.
recipes.about_pl: Już nie babcina pościel.

recipes.name: Makeshift bandage
recipes.about: Better than bleeding.
recipes.about_pl: Lepsze niż krwawienie.

recipes.name: Boil river water
recipes.about: A rolling boil, then back into the bottle. Safe to drink.
recipes.about_pl: Porządnie zagotować, potem z powrotem do butelki. Można pić.

recipes.name: Clean bandage
recipes.about: Rags boiled with disinfectant, as good as the shop's.
recipes.about_pl: Szmaty wygotowane ze środkiem dezynfekującym, dobre jak ze sklepu.

recipes.name: Vodka for the wounds
recipes.about: Strong enough to clean a cut. The booklet doesn't say what else it's good for.
recipes.about_pl: Na tyle mocna, żeby oczyścić skaleczenie. Broszura nie mówi, do czego jeszcze się nadaje.

recipes.name: Boil rice
recipes.about: A whole pot: more filling than the dry rice.
recipes.about_pl: Cały garnek: syci bardziej niż suchy ryż.

recipes.name: Hot soup
recipes.about: Food and drink in one, and warm.
recipes.about_pl: Jedzenie i picie w jednym, i ciepłe.

recipes.name: Herbata (a mug of tea)
recipes.about: The end of the world can wait five minutes.
recipes.about_pl: Koniec świata może poczekać pięć minut.

recipes.name: Kabanos on rusks
recipes.about: Road food, the classic way.
recipes.about_pl: Jedzenie na drogę, po staremu.

recipes.name: Kartacze
recipes.about: Potato dumplings with meat, the Podlasie way. Wigraszek's are better, but Wigraszek is closed.
recipes.about_pl: Pyzy ziemniaczane z mięsem, po podlasku. W Wigraszku lepsze, ale Wigraszek zamknięty.

recipes.name: Placki ziemniaczane
recipes.about: Grated potatoes and onion, fried on whatever's left in the pan. No flour, no oil, no complaints.
recipes.about_pl: Starte ziemniaki i cebula, smażone na tym, co zostało w garnku. Bez mąki, bez oleju, bez narzekania.

recipes.name: Molotov cocktail
recipes.about: A waste of good vodka. For when throwing things is in the game.
recipes.about_pl: Szkoda dobrej wódki. Na czas, kiedy w grze będzie można rzucać.

recipes.name: Start a bigos
recipes.about: Sauerkraut stewed in your saucepan: six servings, thin for now. Add what you find, reheat it, wait for day three.
recipes.about_pl: Kiszona kapusta duszona w twoim garnku: sześć porcji, na razie rzadki. Dodawaj, co znajdziesz, podgrzewaj, czekaj do trzeciego dnia.

recipes.name: Bigos: add meat
recipes.about: Kiełbasa if you have it, a tin if you don't.
recipes.about_pl: Kiełbasa, jeśli masz, a jak nie, to konserwa.

recipes.name: Bigos: add dried mushrooms
recipes.about: The smell of the forest in a pot.
recipes.about_pl: Zapach lasu w garnku.

recipes.name: Bigos: add prunes
recipes.about: A little sweetness against the sour.
recipes.about_pl: Trochę słodyczy do kwaśnego.

recipes.name: Bigos: add fresh cabbage
recipes.about: Shredded fresh with the sour: the way most families do it.
recipes.about_pl: Poszatkowana świeża do kiszonej: tak robi większość rodzin.

recipes.name: Bigos: add onion
recipes.about: Chopped and thrown in.
recipes.about_pl: Posiekana i do garnka.

recipes.name: Bigos: reheat
recipes.about: Everyone knows bigos is best on the third day. Up to three times.
recipes.about_pl: Każdy wie, że bigos najlepszy jest trzeciego dnia. Najwyżej trzy razy.
